title: Perturbed saddle-point problems in $\mathrm{L}^p$ with non-regular loads
summary: In this work, we develop the continuous and discrete solvability analysis for perturbed saddle-point problems in Banach spaces with forcing terms regularised by means of a projector constructed using the adjoint of a weighted Clément quasi-interpolation. We take as driving example the linearised Poisson--Boltzmann equation (an advection-diffusion-reaction problem) in mixed form.
